this_court: affirms the district court and holds that 33 C.F.R. § 151.25 requires foreign-flagged vessels to keep accurate (or at least not knowingly inaccurate) Oil Record Books in U.S. waters, following the Second, Fifth, Third, and First Circuits
quote: Korotkiy does not offer a “compelling reason” to chart a separate course and “create a circuit split.”
cite: United States v. Korotkiy, 118 F.4th 1202 (9th Cir. 2024)
